about_short_description.short_description: Nuna works with government, employers, and plans to improve how people use healthcare through data.

product.name: Nuna App
product.description: A mobile application that helps patients manage chronic conditions by tracking health metrics, medication adherence, and daily activities, while connecting them securely with their healthcare providers.

product.name: Medicaid Data Pipeline and Dataset
product.description: A data infrastructure solution that collects, processes, and manages Medicaid healthcare data for government agencies and healthcare organizations.

product.name: Care Team Integration Platform
product.description: A platform that integrates patient data and care management workflows with healthcare providers' electronic medical records (EMR) systems to support coordinated care.

product.name: Patient Engagement and Rewards System
product.description: A system within the Nuna App that incentivizes patients to follow their care plans by awarding points and rewards redeemable for gift cards and sweepstakes entries.
